theorem regionS {Q Q₀ : ℝ} (hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q) (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀)
    (hρ : Real.log Q₀ ≤ 0.6 * Real.log Q) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (hR : 1 ≤ Q₀ / (s * q)) {c' : ℝ} (hc' : 0 < c') (hlq : 3 ≤ Real.log q)
    (hcc : Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * Real.log c' +
      2.50637 / Real.log (Real.log q) ≤ 0.86)
    (hh : Real.log q + 1.039 * (Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ c' * ((q : ℝ) * (Q₀ / (s * q))) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9)) :
    Gq q (Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ (Real.log Q₀ + 1.36) / (Real.log Q + cE) * Gq q (Q / (s * q)) :=

note: As [H] (12.21), up to notation. Lean proves the small-R bound directly with log Q + c_E in the denominator, which is what (12.23) needs; at σ = 1.36 (12.21) is weaker than (12.23) by the factor (log Q + c_E)/(log Q + 1.312). regionS now assumes only PlattGRH.
